rundown: Badgers beat Beavers 8-2 at LaBahn Arena in Madison, WI. Badgers led 7-1 after two periods and never looked back. The 1st period decided it: Badgers won it 4-0.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 22, 12:58 PM ET. It had Beavers 24% and Badgers 76%, projecting Beavers 2.3 – Badgers 3.9 (6.2 total, Badgers by 1.6).

Final: Beavers 2 – Badgers 8. Right winner: it had Badgers at 76%.

Thin data: 0 of 6 key inputs were sourced (missing: BST goals scored, BST goals allowed, BST lineup rating or past seasons, WIS goals scored, WIS goals allowed, WIS lineup rating or past seasons), so league averages filled the gaps. It was logged as a no-data call: graded and learned from, never offered as a bet.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Beavers came in with a 5% below average attack and a 7% leakier than average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 23 and 23 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.3, they scored 2 (−0.3 goals, 12% under); projected to allow 3.9, they allowed 8 (+4.1 goals, 105% over).

Badgers came in with a 16% above average attack and a 5% stingier than average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 23 and 23 games of evidence. Projected to score 3.9, they scored 8 (+4.1 goals, 105% over); projected to allow 2.3, they allowed 2 (−0.3 goals, 12% under).

The bigger miss was Badgers' scoring (+4.1 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 10 against 6.2 projected (+3.8), about the 94th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±2.4).

Margin: Badgers by 6 against Badgers by 1.6 projected, about the 96th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±2.4).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.body:

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.484 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +4.3 goals. It counts toward Hockey+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 234 graded Hockey+ games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -0.1 goals. Team corrections so far: Beavers attack ×0.960, defense ×1.040 (7 games); Badgers attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 4.4 goals), no bet.
